First, note the given date: 08-26-1442 (likely in Hijri calendar, but the problem says "Use Gregorian calendar arithmetic" in CATEGORY_RULES, so I'll treat 08-26-1442 as Gregorian date: August 26, 1442).

Subtract 47 weeks and 3 days:  
47 weeks = 47 × 7 = 329 days.  
Plus 3 days = 332 days total to subtract.

1442 is not a leap year (divisible by 4 but not by 100 in Gregorian? Actually Gregorian leap year rules start 1582, but for pre-1582 we use proleptic Gregorian: year 1442 is not leap because 1442 mod 4 = 2).  

Start: August 26, 1442.  
Subtract 332 days:  

Go back to start of August 1442: August 1 is 25 days earlier than Aug 26 (since 26 - 1 = 25).  
332 - 25 = 307 days left to go back from Aug 1, 1442.

From Aug 1, go into July 1442: July has 31 days, so July 1 is 31 days earlier than Aug 1.  
307 - 31 = 276 days left from July 1, 1442.

Go month by month backward from July 1, 1442:  
June 1442: 30 days → 276 - 30 = 246  
May: 31 → 246 - 31 = 215  
April: 30 → 215 - 30 = 185  
March: 31 → 185 - 31 = 154  
February: 28 (1442 not leap) → 154 - 28 = 126  
January: 31 → 126 - 31 = 95  
December 1441: 31 → 95 - 31 = 64  
November 1441: 30 → 64 - 30 = 34  
October 1441: 31 → 34 - 31 = 3 days left to go back from Oct 1, 1441.

Oct 1 minus 3 days = September 28, 1441.

FINAL_ANSWER: 1441-09-28
